svg.aria-label: One controller, two front doors, every route: 1. Class: GatewayClass envoy points at the EnvoyProxy envoy, which runs the proxies in the network namespace. 2. Gateway: envoy-external and envoy-internal each open a plain HTTP listener for the redirect and an HTTPS listener on the wildcard Secret. 3. Route: HTTPRoutes from any namespace attach to the HTTPS listeners. The HTTP listeners take only the same-namespace redirect. 4. Proxy: The controller pushes config to each Envoy pod over xDS. On shutdown a pod drains for up to 180 seconds before it exits.
